title: Record a run event input
description: A record of a run, from the runtime or written by the daemon itself (kind starts with `runbook.`; the commands that write one declare it, see EventKind): keep it, unchanged, under its sequence number (per run, only grows) and its position (per daemon, minted by the daemon, only grows over all runs). Every run of the daemon holds `runbook.submitted` at sequence 1 from its submit (SubmitRun), so the first record of the runtime is sequence 2, and the daemon's own events take positions too: the runtime's first record comes after the positions the submits used. The handler fills `position` and `session_id` (copied from the run). An event for a run that has ended, was cancelled or failed to start is refused.

sdc.daemon.EventKind.title: EventKind
sdc.daemon.EventKind.description: Open text: the kind of the runtime's run-log line, copied. Events the daemon writes itself have a kind that starts with `runbook.`, and the command that writes each one declares it: runbook.submitted (SubmitRun), runbook.context-copied (ContextPath), runbook.cancel-requested (CancelRun), runbook.start-failed (FailRunStart), runbook.run-orphaned (EndOrphanedRun), runbook.answer-undeliverable (AnswerDecision) and runbook.runtime-failed (written by the daemon just before it issues EndRun with the outcome runtime-failure), runbook.step-failed (written by the daemon just before it issues EndRun with the outcome `failed: step <action> <end>` (`<end>`: `exit <n>`, `signal <n>`, `timed out after <s> s` or `ended with no exit`), when the last program of the run's tree failed (it ended with an exit other than 0, was killed at its timeout or ended with no exit status, or Loom refused it for an exit its `exits.error` lists or a signal, an agent node (`sdc-node`) or any other program) and the tree has no other action to take; record: case, action, end, exit, signal and timeout_seconds (each of the last three when it applies), reason) and runbook.action-started (written by the daemon when the runtime tells that a program of an action, or its `handoff_when` check, is about to start, before the program starts; record: case, action, role (`program` or `check`) and try, each absent when unknown; the language cannot write a RunEvent from a command, so it is stated here, and the view RunDetail shows the step while the program runs). Not a closed set for the runtime's own kinds.

sdc.daemon.RunId.title: RunId
sdc.daemon.RunId.description: The id of a run. The daemon mints it (a UUID, version 7) in the HTTP handler and returns it in the answer to the submit; the handler fills the `run_id` input of SubmitRun and a client never chooses it. The state directory of the run is named after it. A run id that is already taken cannot occur, because the daemon mints it; the specification has no refusal for it.

sdc.daemon.SessionId.title: SessionId
sdc.daemon.SessionId.description: The name of a session, chosen by the client that opens it.
